# Setup

## Packages

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)   # data wrangling and ggplot2
library(cmdstanr)    # Stan interface
library(posterior)   # draws handling
library(metR)        # contour labels
library(patchwork)   # inset_element()
library(sp)          # point.in.polygon()
library(ks)          # kernel density estimation (credible region)
```

## Paths

```{r paths}
data_file  <- "simu_data.csv"
stan_file  <- "paper_bayes.stan"
fig_dir    <- "figures"

dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Helper functions

```{r helpers}
# Back-transform standardized values to the original scale
unscale <- function(x, value) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  value * sd(x) + mean(x)
}

# Unit conversions
lbac_to_kgha <- function(lb)     lb * 1.125       # lb/ac -> kg/ha
in_to_mm     <- function(inches) inches * 25.4    # in -> mm

# Loss functions (used only to illustrate the loss shapes)
sq_loss    <- function(psi, a, y) (psi * (a - y))^2
linex_loss <- function(psi, a, y) exp(psi * (a - y)) - psi * (a - y) - 1
```

## Plot theme and labels

```{r theme}
labs_std <- labs(
  x = expression("Total N fert. (kg" %.% "ha"^{-1}*")"),
  y = expression("Total water (mm" %.% "season"^{-1}*")")
)

theme_std <- function(legend.position = "bottom", base_size = 11) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      panel.border      = element_rect(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.position   = legend.position,
      legend.title      = element_blank(),
      legend.margin     = margin(0, 0, 0, -10),
      legend.box.margin = margin(t = -4),
      legend.key.size   = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      axis.text.x       = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title        = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text         = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.text       = element_text(size = 7),
      plot.margin       = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}
```

# Data and prediction grid

```{r data}
df <- read_csv(data_file) |>
  mutate(
    x1 = as.numeric(scale(N)),      # standardized N
    x2 = as.numeric(scale(water))   # standardized water
  )

summary(df)

# Prediction grid (standardized scale)
grid_N <- seq(min(df$x1), max(df$x1), length.out = 100)
grid_W <- seq(min(df$x2), max(df$x2), length.out = 100)
grid   <- expand.grid(x1 = grid_N, x2 = grid_W)

data_stan <- list(
  N      = nrow(df),
  N_test = nrow(grid),
  K      = length(unique(df$year)),
  year   = df$year,
  y      = df$profit,
  x1     = df$x1,
  x2     = df$x2,
  act_x1 = grid$x1,
  act_x2 = grid$x2,
  psi    = -0.005
)
```

## Axis breaks and labels (original units)

```{r axes}
idx <- round(seq(1, 100, length.out = 10))

N_breaks_std <- grid_N[idx]
W_breaks_std <- grid_W[idx]

N_labels <- unscale(df$N, N_breaks_std) |> lbac_to_kgha() |> round()
W_labels <- unscale(df$water, W_breaks_std) |> in_to_mm() |> round()

scale_x_std <- scale_x_continuous(
  limits = range(N_breaks_std),
  breaks = N_breaks_std, labels = N_labels,
  expand = c(0, 0)
)

scale_y_std <- scale_y_continuous(
  breaks = W_breaks_std, labels = W_labels,
  expand = c(0, 0)
)
```

# Model

```{r model, results='hide'}
model <- cmdstan_model(stan_file)

fit <- model$sample(
  data            = data_stan,
  chains          = 4,
  parallel_chains = 4,
  iter_warmup     = 2000,
  iter_sampling   = 1000,
  seed            = 1248,
  refresh         = 500,
  max_treedepth   = 12,
  adapt_delta     = 0.98,
  show_messages   = FALSE,
  show_exceptions = FALSE
)
```

## Posterior summary

```{r posterior-summary}
summ <- fit$summary(c("x_s", "eigen_val", "eigen_vec",
                      "b0", "b1", "b2", "b3", "b4", "b5",
                      "sigma", "alpha"))
summ

df_draws <- as_draws_df(fit)
```

# Canonical analysis

## Stationary points

```{r stationary-points}
xs_draws <- df_draws |>
  select(N = `x_s[1]`, W = `x_s[2]`)

summary(xs_draws)

xs_mean <- xs_draws |> summarise(N = mean(N), W = mean(W))
xs_N <- xs_mean$N
xs_W <- xs_mean$W

# 95% credible region of the stationary point (kernel density contour)
kd <- ks::kde(xs_draws, compute.cont = TRUE)

contour_95 <- with(kd, contourLines(x = eval.points[[1]],
                                    y = eval.points[[2]],
                                    z = estimate,
                                    levels = cont["5%"])[[1]]) |>
  as.data.frame()

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = xs_draws, aes(x = N, y = W),
             alpha = 0.15, color = "darkcyan", size = 1) +
  annotate("point", x = xs_N, y = xs_W,
           color = "red", size = 4, shape = 4, stroke = 1.5) +
  geom_path(data = contour_95, aes(x, y),
            color = "darkred", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3), breaks = -3:3) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3), breaks = -3:3) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs_std +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Ridge (canonical) axes

```{r ridge-axes}
v1 <- summ |> filter(variable %in% c("eigen_vec[1,1]", "eigen_vec[2,1]")) |> pull(median)
v2 <- summ |> filter(variable %in% c("eigen_vec[1,2]", "eigen_vec[2,2]")) |> pull(median)

s <- seq(min(grid_N), max(grid_N), length.out = 100)

x_lim <- range(N_breaks_std)
y_lim <- range(W_breaks_std)

lines_canonical <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(N = xs_N + s * v1[1], W = xs_W + s * v1[2], axis = "w1"),
  data.frame(N = xs_N + s * v2[1], W = xs_W + s * v2[2], axis = "w2")
) |>
  filter(N >= x_lim[1], N <= x_lim[2],
         W >= y_lim[1], W <= y_lim[2])
```

# Posterior predictions on the grid

```{r grid-predictions}
grid_pred   <- fit$draws("grid_pred", format = "matrix")
profit_pred <- apply(grid_pred, 2, mean) * 2.471   # $/ac -> $/ha
bayes_sd    <- apply(grid_pred, 2, sd)

linex <- fit$draws("loss_linex", format = "matrix") |> colMeans()
ptl   <- fit$draws("loss_ptl",   format = "matrix") |> colMeans()
sl    <- fit$draws("loss_sl",    format = "matrix") |> colMeans()

grid_data <- cbind(grid, profit_pred, bayes_sd, linex, ptl, sl)

# Flag grid cells inside the 95% credible region
grid_data$inside_contour <- sp::point.in.polygon(
  point.x = grid_data$x1,
  point.y = grid_data$x2,
  pol.x   = contour_95$x,
  pol.y   = contour_95$y
) > 0
```

# Figures

## Response surface

```{r fig-rsm}
points_labeled <- tibble(
  point = c("A1", "B1", "A2", "B2"),
  N_p   = c(2.95, -1.55, 0.5, 1.3),
  W_p   = c(1.95, 0.6, 2.6, -0.1)
)

plot_rsm <- ggplot() +
  geom_path(data = lines_canonical,
            aes(x = N, y = W, colour = axis, group = axis),
            linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_contour(data = grid_data,
               aes(x = x1, y = x2, z = profit_pred, colour = "expected profit"),
               alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text_contour(data = grid_data,
                    aes(x = x1, y = x2, z = profit_pred),
                    colour = "black", size = 2.5, skip = 0,
                    nudge_y = 0.1, nudge_x = -0.1) +
  geom_path(data = contour_95, aes(x, y, colour = "CI"), linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("point", x = xs_N, y = xs_W,
           color = "darkred", size = 2.5, shape = 16) +
  geom_point(data = points_labeled, aes(x = N_p, y = W_p), size = 2.1) +
  geom_text(data = points_labeled, aes(x = N_p, y = W_p, label = point),
            vjust = -0.7, size = 2.2, hjust = -0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name   = NULL,
    values = c("expected profit" = "black",
               "CI"              = "darkred",
               "w1"              = "#E69F00",
               "w2"              = "#CC79A7"),
    labels = c("expected profit" = "Expected profit",
               "CI"              = "95% credible interval",
               "w1"              = expression(w[1]),
               "w2"              = expression(w[2])),
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype  = rep("solid", 4),
                                             linewidth = rep(0.8, 4)))) +
  coord_fixed(clip = "on") +
  scale_x_std +
  scale_y_std +
  labs_std +
  theme_std()

plot_rsm
```

## Profit, uncertainty and credible region

```{r fig-profit-sd}
plot_profit_sd <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = subset(grid_data,
                            profit_pred >= 600 & bayes_sd <= 15 & inside_contour),
              aes(x = x1, y = x2), fill = "palegreen", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_contour(data = grid_data,
               aes(x = x1, y = x2, z = profit_pred, colour = "E(Profit)"),
               alpha = 0.65) +
  geom_contour(data = grid_data,
               aes(x = x1, y = x2, z = bayes_sd, colour = "SD(Profit)"),
               linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.85, breaks = seq(0, 120, 15)) +
  geom_text_contour(data = grid_data,
                    aes(x = x1, y = x2, z = bayes_sd),
                    colour = "black", size = 2.5, skip = 0, nudge_y = 0.15,
                    breaks = seq(0, 120, 15),
                    label.placer = label_placer_fraction(frac = 0.5)) +
  geom_path(data = contour_95, aes(x, y, colour = "CI"), linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name   = NULL,
    values = c("E(Profit)" = "black", "CI" = "darkred", "SD(Profit)" = "black"),
    labels = c("E(Profit)"  = "Expected profit",
               "CI"         = "95% credible interval",
               "SD(Profit)" = "Standard deviation"),
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
      linetype  = c("solid", "solid", "dashed"),
      linewidth = c(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)))) +
  coord_fixed(clip = "on") +
  scale_x_std +
  scale_y_std +
  labs_std +
  theme_std()

plot_profit_sd
```

## Loss functions

```{r}
y_test <- -400:400

plot_loss_fn <- data.frame(
  action = y_test,
  square = sq_loss(psi = -0.005, a = y_test, y = 200),
  linex  = linex_loss(psi = -0.005, a = y_test, y = 200)
) |>
  ggplot(aes(action)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = square, color = "Square"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = linex,  color = "Linex"),  linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Square" = "#0072B2", "Linex" = "black")) +
  labs(x = expression("Expected profit ($" %.% "ha"^{-1}*")"),
       y = "Loss", color = "Loss function") +
  theme_std()

plot_loss_fn
```

## Linex loss maps

```{r fig-loss-maps}
# Shared color scale (quantiles of the linex loss)
loss_qs     <- quantile(grid_data$linex, probs = c(0, .25, .5, .75, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
loss_colors <- c("#004588", "#115594", "gray", "#ee3229", "#8d191c")

scale_fill_loss <- scale_fill_gradientn(
  name    = "Loss",
  colours = loss_colors,
  values  = scales::rescale(loss_qs, to = c(0, 1)),
  limits  = range(loss_qs),
  breaks  = range(loss_qs),
  guide   = "none"
)

# Custom color-bar legend (low/high risk)
legend_df <- data.frame(ymin = 0:4, ymax = 1:5, fill = loss_colors)

p_legend <- ggplot(legend_df) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 0.35, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = fill)) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  annotate("text", x = 0.45, y = 4.9, label = "High risk", hjust = 0, size = 2.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.45, y = 0.1, label = "Low risk",  hjust = 0, size = 2.5) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1.6), ylim = c(0, 5), clip = "off", expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 2, 1, 0))

legend_inset <- function(p) {
  p + inset_element(p_legend, left = 1., right = 1.17, bottom = 0.25, top = 0.75)
}

# (a) Loss + expected profit
p_loss_a <- ggplot(grid_data, aes(x = x1, y = x2)) +
  geom_raster(aes(fill = linex), interpolate = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_loss +
  geom_contour(aes(z = profit_pred, color = "E"), alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text_contour(aes(z = profit_pred),
                    colour = "black", size = 2.5, skip = 0,
                    nudge_y = 0.1, nudge_x = -0.1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name   = NULL,
    values = c("E" = "black"),
    labels = c("E" = "Expected profit"),
    guide  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8))) +
  coord_fixed(clip = "on") +
  scale_x_std +
  scale_y_std +
  labs_std +
  labs(tag = "a") +
  theme_std() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 0, 1, 0))

# (b) Loss + expected profit + SD
p_loss_b <- ggplot(grid_data, aes(x = x1, y = x2)) +
  geom_raster(aes(fill = linex), interpolate = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_loss +
  geom_contour(aes(z = profit_pred),
               colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_contour(aes(z = bayes_sd, color = "SD"),
               breaks = seq(0, 90, 15), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text_contour(aes(z = bayes_sd), breaks = seq(0, 90, 15),
                    colour = "black", size = 2.5, nudge_y = 0.2, skip = 0,
                    label.placer = label_placer_fraction(frac = 0.5)) +
  scale_color_manual(name   = NULL,
                     values = c("SD" = "black"),
                     labels = c("SD" = "Standard deviation")) +
  coord_fixed(clip = "on") +
  scale_x_std +
  scale_y_std +
  labs_std +
  labs(tag = "b") +
  theme_std() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 0, 1, 0))

p_loss_a <- legend_inset(p_loss_a)
p_loss_b <- legend_inset(p_loss_b)

print(p_loss_a)
print(p_loss_b)
```

# Efficiency analysis

## N and water use efficiency (NUE, WUE)

```{r efficiency-data}
grid_eff <- grid_data |>
  mutate(
    N_orig = unscale(df$N,     x1),   # original units (lb/ac)
    W_orig = unscale(df$water, x2),   # original units (in)
    NUE    = profit_pred / N_orig,
    WUE    = profit_pred / W_orig
  ) |>
  filter(is.finite(NUE), is.finite(WUE)) |>
  mutate(
    NUE = case_when(NUE < 0    ~ "Inefficient",
                    NUE < 3.65 ~ "Low",
                    TRUE       ~ "High"),
    WUE = case_when(WUE < 0  ~ "Inefficient",
                    WUE < 24 ~ "Low",
                    TRUE     ~ "High"),
    across(c(NUE, WUE),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c("High", "Low", "Inefficient")))
  )
```

```{r fig-nue-wue}
grid_joint <- grid_eff |>
  mutate(
    fill_joint = case_when(
      WUE == "High" & NUE == "High"               ~ "High joint\nefficiency",
      NUE == "Inefficient" | WUE == "Inefficient" ~ "Inefficient",
      TRUE                                        ~ "Low\nefficiency"))

plot_nue_wue <- ggplot(grid_joint) +
  geom_raster(aes(x1, x2, fill = fill_joint)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "",
    values = c("High joint\nefficiency" = "#115594",
               "Low\nefficiency"        = "gray90",
               "Inefficient"            = "gray45")) +
  geom_contour(aes(x1, x2, z = as.numeric(NUE == "High"), linetype = "ENP High"),
               breaks = 0.5, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_contour(aes(x1, x2, z = as.numeric(WUE == "High"), linetype = "EWP High"),
               breaks = 0.5, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name   = "",
    values = c("EWP High" = "dotdash", "ENP High" = "dotted")) +
  guides(
    fill     = guide_legend(order = 1),
    linetype = guide_legend(order = 2,
                            override.aes = list(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8))) +
  coord_fixed(clip = "on") +
  scale_x_std +
  scale_y_std +
  labs_std +
  theme_std(legend.position = "right")

plot_nue_wue
```

## Efficiency, risk and uncertainty

```{r fig-efficiency-risk}
data_efficiency <- grid_eff |>
  mutate(
    loss_high    = linex > 0.05,
    sd_high      = bayes_sd > 15,
    ineff        = NUE == "Inefficient" | WUE == "Inefficient",
    eff_high     = NUE == "High" & WUE == "High",
    eff_high_num = as.numeric(eff_high),
    fill_joint = case_when(
      eff_high  & !loss_high & !sd_high ~ "Optimal region",
      eff_high  & (loss_high | sd_high) ~ "Efficient but\nrisky",
      !eff_high & !loss_high & !sd_high ~ "Safe but not\nefficient",
      ineff                             ~ "Inefficient",
      TRUE                              ~ "Poor"),
    fill_joint = factor(fill_joint,
                        levels = c("Optimal region", "Efficient but\nrisky",
                                   "Safe but not\nefficient", "Inefficient", "Poor"))
  )

plot_efficiency <- ggplot(data_efficiency) +
  geom_raster(aes(x1, x2, fill = fill_joint)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = NULL,
    values = c("Optimal region"          = "palegreen",
               "Efficient but\nrisky"    = "#115594",
               "Safe but not\nefficient" = "orange",
               "Inefficient"             = "gray45",
               "Poor"                    = "gray90")) +
  geom_contour(aes(x1, x2, z = linex, linetype = "Lower risk"),
               breaks = 0.05, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_contour(aes(x1, x2, z = bayes_sd, linetype = "Lower uncertainty"),
               breaks = 15, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_contour(aes(x1, x2, z = eff_high_num, linetype = "High joint\nefficiency"),
               breaks = 0.5, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name   = "Contours",
    values = c("Lower risk"             = "dotted",
               "Lower uncertainty"      = "dashed",
               "High joint\nefficiency" = "solid")) +
  guides(
    fill     = guide_legend(order = 1),
    linetype = guide_legend(order = 2,
                            override.aes = list(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8))) +
  coord_fixed(clip = "on") +
  scale_x_std +
  scale_y_std +
  labs_std +
  theme_std(legend.position = "right")

plot_efficiency
```
